title: Breathwork Session Length by Time of Day
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breathwork:session
| search minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(minutes) as avg_minutes count as sessions by _time daypart
| sort - _time
description: Tracks breathwork session length over time and breaks it out by time of day.
value: Time-of-day splits help you place breathwork where it naturally fits instead of where it sounds ideal.
implementation: Send breathwork session length events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of breathwork session length by time of day.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how breathwork session length changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
